blocks.html: Robinsons Land (RLC) strengthens its support for urban mobility through its partnership with the MMDA Love Bus program, deploying two dedicated RLC buses that will serve key commuter corridors, connecting to some of Metro Manila's busiest districts - Quezon City and Pasig City.

This initiative provides commuters with a more convenient and accessible transport option while helping ease traffic congestion along major routes that traverse Ortigas Business District as well as the growing business communities in Bridgetowne, RLC’s premier destination estate.

“Robinsons Land recognizes the growing need for efficient mobility solutions that will help Filipinos navigate their daily travel challenge,” says Ms. Mybelle V. Aragon GoBio, president and CEO, Robinsons Land. By extending transportation access across high-traffic areas, the MMDA Love Bus initiative aims to reduce commuting friction, support productivity, and make every day journeys more seamless for thousands of Filipino workers, students, and residents. The deployment of RLC buses reflects the company's commitment to creating developments and partnerships that deliver meaningful benefits beyond its properties and contribute to more connected communities.

The launch was attended by First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, Antipolo Mayor Jun Ynares III, Pasig Mayor Vico Sotto, and Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte, together with Robinsons Land executives led by President and CEO Mybelle V. Aragon-GoBio and Executive Vice President and Group Business Unit General Manager Robinsons Malls and Robinsons Destination Estates Faraday D. Go. The collaboration highlights the shared commitment of public and private sector stakeholders to advancing practical transportation solutions that improve mobility, ease daily commutes, and enhance the overall quality of life for Filipinos.

From the heart of the city to the communities we serve. Robinsons Land is proud to support the MMDA Love Bus and its mission to make commuting more convenient, accessible, and sustainable for Filipinos.
